description:
Generate and commit DER test fixtures for trust anchor NC enforcement tests.

**What:** Use pyca/cryptography to create a minimal PKI where the trust anchor cert carries a NameConstraints extension, plus leaf certs that pass and fail the constraints.

**Algorithm:**
1. Write a Python script pkix-path/tests/gen_anchor_nc_fixtures.py using cryptography library (same pattern as pkix-revocation/tests/gen_ocsp_cross_ca_fixture.py).
2. Script generates:
   a. anchor-nc-permitted-dns: self-signed CA cert with NC extension permittedSubtrees={dNSName:.example.com}. Key: P-256.
   b. anchor-nc-excluded-dns: self-signed CA cert with NC extension excludedSubtrees={dNSName:.example.com}. Key: P-256.
   c. leaf-good-dns: end-entity cert signed by anchor-nc-permitted-dns CA, with SAN dNSName=good.example.com
   d. leaf-evil-dns: end-entity cert signed by anchor-nc-permitted-dns CA, with SAN dNSName=evil.other.com
   e. leaf-excluded-dns: end-entity cert signed by anchor-nc-excluded-dns CA, with SAN dNSName=bad.example.com
3. All certs use validity 2020-01-01 to 2030-01-01 (to be valid during PKITS_NOW = 2020-01-01).
4. Commit script and DER files to pkix-path/tests/fixtures/anchor-nc/.
5. Print hex fingerprints of all generated certs for verification.

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Script must set keyUsage keyCertSign + cRLSign on the CA cert (required for intermediate checks in chain_walk).
- Script must set basicConstraints cA=TRUE on the CA cert.
- Leaf certs must NOT have basicConstraints cA=TRUE.
- Validity period must include 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z (PKITS_NOW).
- Do NOT derive test vectors from the code under test; use pyca as the oracle.

**Tests:** the fixture DER files are the oracle for W3A tests. No Rust tests in this bead.
title: Generate test fixtures: trust anchor with NameConstraints (pyca/cryptography)
